title: Guide to lead generation for local businesses - Google Ads

facts.fact: The Google article 'Guide to lead generation for local businesses' is dated August 2025.
Under the pay-per-lead (PPL) model, the page says the advertiser pays only when it gets a qualified lead, unlike pay-per-click.
facts.quote: This is where a pay-per-lead (PPL) model can help, since you only pay when you get a qualified lead.

facts.fact: Under pay-per-click (PPC), the page says the advertiser pays an advertising platform such as Google Ads each time someone clicks on the ad.
facts.quote: Traditional online advertising uses a pay-per-click (PPC) model, where you’ll pay an advertising platform like Google Ads anytime someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: Google states that multiple campaigns can be created within the same Google Ads account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: The page's illustrative example says a local plumber can only consider the few hundred or thousand customers within visiting distance, compared with a global e-commerce brand's audience of millions.
facts.quote: a plumber can only consider the few hundred or thousand customers within visiting distance.

facts.fact: Google defines tracking conversions in Google Ads as starting by defining which desirable behaviors to track as 'conversion actions'.
facts.quote: you’ll start by defining which desirable behaviors you want to track as “conversion actions.”
